study_type_evidence.quote: Each dose was delivered subcutaneously between the shoulder blades of the animals (n = 3 per treatment group) (Fig. 1).
An AH1F fibroblast suspension containing 60,000 cells in 2% fetal bovine serum (FBS) + Dulbecco's Modified Eagle's Medium (DMEM) was added to a 35 mm Glass bottom dish
A typical ITC experiment involved titration of a 35 μM peptide solution into a cell filled with 1.4 mL of 2.7 μM human plasma fibronectin

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: female nude athymic, 8-10 weeks old, 20-23 g (Envigo)
in_vivo_species.quote: Female nude athymic 8–10 week old, 20–23 g mice were purchased from Envigo (Madison, WI)

in_vitro_detail: Two in vitro systems: (1) isothermal titration calorimetry of FUD-Cy5, 20 kDa PEG-FUD-Cy5 and unlabelled FUD titrated into purified human plasma fibronectin in PBS pH 7.4 at 25 °C (cell-free, purified protein); (2) confocal fluorescence microscopy of sulfo-Cy5-labelled peptides binding to Alexa Fluor 488-labelled human plasma fibronectin matrix assembled by cultured AH1F human foreskin fibroblasts. RP-HPLC and ion-exchange chromatography were used for analytical characterisation only.

concentration_time_figure.locator: Fig. 8a (FUD series) and Fig. 9a (mFUD series); supporting images in Fig. 7 and Additional file 4: Fig. S4
concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: Percentage of drug dose (FSC %) remaining at the site of s.c. injection over time after administration of a FUD or 10 kDa, 20 kDa, or 40 kDa PEG-FUD
concentration_time_figure.note: Percent-of-dose-remaining versus time at the subcutaneous injection site, measured by non-invasive IVIS fluorescence; this is a depot-depletion (absorption) curve, not a plasma concentration-time curve. Fig. 8b and 9b plot apparent t1/2 against peptide molecular weight (linear fits r2 = 0.97 and 0.99). Time points: pre-injection, immediately post-injection, 30 min and 1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 36, 48 h.

bioanalytical_method: Non-invasive in vivo fluorescence imaging (IVIS Spectrum, Perkin Elmer; ex 660 nm / em 680 nm) of sulfo-Cy5-labelled peptide, quantified as radiant efficiency in regions of interest with LivingImage software
bioanalytical_quote: Fluorescence imaging of the s.c. site of injection was carried out using the IVIS Spectrum (Perkin Elmer) system using a filter set with an excitation wavelength of 660 nm
notes: All reported half-lives are APPARENT ABSORPTION half-lives (50% loss of fluorescence signal from the subcutaneous depot), not plasma elimination half-lives; no plasma or serum concentrations were measured in this study, so cmax and tmax are absent throughout. Half-lives were derived from a one-phase decay fit applied to different terminal windows for each peptide (0-48 h for FUD/mFUD, 1-48 h for 10 kDa, 3-48 h for 20 kDa and 6-48 h for 40 kDa conjugates) because larger drugs showed an initial signal-reduction lag. No amino acid sequence is given anywhere in the body for FUD or mFUD; the sequences shown in the peplife2 header block are database metadata and were not used. Kidney and bladder fluorescence localisation over time is described qualitatively (Fig. 10, Fig. 11) without quantified concentrations. ITC binding constants (Table 1) are in vitro affinity data, not PK. Vehicle for all doses was PBS pH 7.4, but PBS alone was not dosed as a separate control arm, so it is not listed as an agent.
